description: This file implements the RequestHandler class, which manages lifecycle requests, initialization, termination, and interactions with other components such as RippleHandler, RuntimeManagerHandler, and WindowManagerHandler within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing lifecycle requests, initialization, termination, and communication with other components within the plugin framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RequestHandler, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RequestHandler with the provided service and event handler, setting up internal components.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up internal components of the RequestHandler.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Updates the lifecycle state to launch the application context.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Updates the lifecycle state to terminate the application context.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent to the application context and updates the most recent intent.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Creates and adds a state transition request for the given context and target state.

methods.name: getRuntimeManagerHandler
methods.description: Returns the runtime manager handler instance.

methods.name: getWindowManagerHandler
methods.description: Returns the window manager handler instance.
